comic_claim: The news cycle moves so fast that horror becomes background noise within days.
comic_model: The audience is the joke: we all keep swiping.

derivations.premise: Friend shows a dark statistic; reaction escalates then collapses to yeah probably nothing; back to swiping.

facts.claim: High-profile cases with suspicious deaths recur in the news cycle.
Public attention decays within days regardless of severity.

reality_model: Outrage cycles compress to days; apathy is the stable state.
